name: customer-support-analyzer
description: Automated Customer Support Ticket & Call Analyzer

scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js "cd server && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs src/server.ts" "cd client && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --port 5173"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs watch src/server.ts
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && cd ../server && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc
